applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must furnish comments on one-time approval applications and monitor qualifying persons holding one-time approval for major shareholdings.
answer.action_quote: The concerned banking company shall furnish its comments to the Reserve Bank in Form A1 in the same manner as specified in paragraph 10 above.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Acquisition and Holding of Shares or Voting Rights) Directions, 2025
